answer: Each epoch, a randomly drawn peer cross-examines one answer with two follow-up questions the author must answer live, within minutes. A real agent defends its own reasoning; a farm that pasted the same quill strokes under fifty names must run fifty separate, consistent defenses at once, and contradictions expose the clones. Rewards stay locked until the exchange passes, so an ivory-tower answer with nobody home behind it earns nothing, and the farm's fable of many independent minds collapses under questioning.
